source.name: The Inner Ring — Women's Pro Team Sponsors Explained
source.quote: FDJ United-Suez sees the French state lottery provider and now Europe's second biggest gambling company alongside Suez
source.note: FDJ United and Suez are the team's two headline (title) names; the club's partners page lists both under 'Partenaires Titres'.

source.name: Cyclist — Who actually are the Tour de France team sponsors? (Wayback Machine snapshot, 1 September 2025)
source.quote: FDJ joined the women's team formerly known as Vienne Futuroscope and Poitou-Charentes.Futoroscope.86 in 2017, going five years as FDJ-Nouvelle Aquitaine-Futuroscope before Suez joined in 2022.
source.note: Translation not needed (English). The live cyclist.co.uk page blocks scripts (HTTP 403), so the archived snapshot is cited; Suez is co-title partner on the chest ('Partenaires Titres' on the club's partners page).

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Gan Assurances (Groupe Groupama) renoue avec le cyclisme (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: le logo Gan Assurances figurera sur les manches et la poitrine droite du maillot FDJ-SUEZ, pour une durée de 3 ans
source.note: Translation: 'the Gan Assurances logo will appear on the sleeves and right chest of the FDJ-SUEZ jersey, for three years.'

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Adagio devient partenaire majeur de l'équipe FDJ-SUEZ (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Adagio s’affichera fièrement sur la face avant et le dos du maillot de l’équipe FDJ-SUEZ
source.note: Translation: 'Adagio will proudly appear on the front and back of the FDJ-SUEZ team jersey' (from 25 June 2025, for four years).

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Adagio devient partenaire majeur de l'équipe FDJ-SUEZ (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Adagio s’affichera fièrement sur la face avant et le dos du maillot de l’équipe FDJ-SUEZ
source.note: Translation: 'Adagio will proudly appear on the front and back of the FDJ-SUEZ team jersey' (from 25 June 2025, for four years).

source.name: The Inner Ring — Women's Pro Team Sponsors Explained
source.quote: Beyond the two headline names the jersey is notable for more blue chip names like Gan insurance and CB which is France's answer to Visa payments
source.note: CB is Cartes Bancaires; also a 'Partenaire Majeur' on the club's partners page. The exact on-shirt position is not stated.

source.name: FDJ UNITED-SUEZ — Red Bull rejoint FDJ United-Suez comme partenaire majeur de l'équipe (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Red Bull devient partenaire majeur et Official Energy Drink Partner de l’équipe, et son logo s’affichera sur les casques des athlètes FDJ UNITED-SUEZ
source.note: Translation: 'Red Bull becomes a major partner and Official Energy Drink Partner of the team, and its logo will appear on the helmets of the FDJ UNITED-SUEZ athletes.' The logo is on the helmets, not the jersey; the schema has no helmet placement, so it is recorded as 'partner'.

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — FDJ-SUEZ dévoile son maillot 2026 à l'occasion du Tour de France (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: La tenue Gobik équipera ensuite l’équipe FDJ-SUEZ sur l’ensemble de la saison 2026
source.note: Translation: 'The Gobik kit will then outfit the FDJ-SUEZ team for the whole 2026 season.' Gobik is the team's kit maker (équipementier); its brand is the maker of the jersey rather than a printed sponsor logo.

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — FDJ-SUEZ et Specialized : une alliance au service de l'innovation et de la performance (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Specialized, leader mondial de l’innovation dans le cyclisme, et l’équipe professionnelle FDJ-SUEZ annoncent avec enthousiasme le début de leur partenariat stratégique, à compter de 2025
source.note: Translation: 'Specialized, world leader in cycling innovation, and the professional team FDJ-SUEZ enthusiastically announce the start of their strategic partnership, from 2025.' Bike supplier ('Partenaires Techniques' on the club's partners page).

source.name: FDJ-SUEZ — Un partenariat fait pour durer : FDJ-SUEZ et SHIMANO (communiqué officiel)
source.quote: Shimano accompagne fidèlement l’équipe et continuera d’être son partenaire technique officiel pour les saisons 2025 et 2026
source.note: Translation: 'Shimano will continue as the team's official technical partner for the 2025 and 2026 seasons', supplying the DURA-ACE Di2 groupset ('Partenaires Techniques' on the club's partners page).

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam named for title partners FDJ United and Suez ('Partenaires Titres'). Club communiqués place Gan Assurances on the sleeves and right chest (2025-06-06), Adagio on the front and back (2025-06-16) and Gobik as kit maker for the whole 2026 season; The Inner Ring (Aug 2026) adds Cartes Bancaires (CB) on the jersey; Red Bull (major partner from 1 Aug 2026) shows its logo on the riders' helmets; Specialized (bikes) and Shimano (groupsets) are technical partners. sponsorsComplete stays false: on-shirt positions beyond those named above could not be checked from text sources, and the club's partners page also lists institutional partners, official suppliers and local partner clubs not recorded here.
